decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down (radio and CMMS agree). Likely repair is 13:30, high is 14:30. TJ-C564-14 holds 134 t at 12.1 g/t, about 52 oz. LH-09 is 0.34 h away and loads 29.1 t/h, so it clears the stope in about 4.6 h, before 17:00. The cost is about 5 h x 1.5 oz/h = ~8 oz of development value. Central's stockpile has 174 of 450 t, so the small truck excess (107 vs 91 t/h) is absorbed. LH-08 is farther away (0.71 h) and no better. LH-10 is in preventive maintenance until 12:00. Net gain is about 40 oz.

Keep LH-09 on C564-14 (128 t at 12.1 g/t, ~50 oz, dev cost 1.5 oz/h is far lower). LH-03 down at C590-07 until ~13:40 with 316 t at 8.4 g/t. Este is truck-limited (inflow 101 vs trucks 72, stockpile 167), so lending an Este loader costs little. LH-06 (LH514, 0.45 h away, 35.6 t/h there) gives ~200 t, ~55 oz, minus ~10 oz Este loss. Central has truck headroom since LH-01 and LH-03 are both down. LH-08 would cost 1 oz/h and 0.67 h of travel. LH-10 is in PM until 12:00. CMMS and radio agree on both failures, so no confirmation is needed.

Keep LH-06 at C590-07 (about 9.6 oz/h vs 7.2 at home) and LH-09 at C564-14 (about 11.3 oz/h vs 1.5 dev). Norte has no loader, 274 t at 5.8 g/t waiting, and an empty stockpile with truck room. Move LH-08 from DS-N522-01 (1.0 oz/h) to N600-08: 0.41 h travel, about 5.1 oz/h, so net about +4 oz/h over roughly 6 h. LH-10 is in PM until 12:00. No reserves, since no stope is stopped. The radio and CMMS agree on all three failures.
